notes: Recorded 31 master's-level rows (30 programmes, with the MA in Contemporary Islamic Studies counted twice for its two specialisations; includes the Juris Doctor and the two LL.M. programmes) and 11 doctoral programmes (10 PhD and the S.J.D.). Together with the 4 certificates not recorded, this matches the 45 graduate programmes on the official tuition page.

Not recorded: the graduate certificates (Graduate Certificate in Islamic Studies, in Islamic Finance, in Islamic Psychology and Psychotherapy, and the Certificate in Public Policy). The scholarship page gives certificates a 0% waiver and the College of Islamic Studies states there are no scholarships for international students on its certificates.

The first pass listed 25 master's and 11 doctoral rows (the master's list was cut at 25); this pass adds Master in Global Health Policy, MSc in Economics, MA in Comparative Education (School of Education, listed on the tuition page and the HBKU programme catalogue), the Juris Doctor and the two LL.M. programmes. The doctoral list is unchanged and complete.
The Juris Doctor is filed under master's because applicants enter it with a bachelor's degree; HBKU treats it as its own category (60% waiver).
Waiver categories: PhD STEM and SHAPE and S.J.D. 100%; STEM master's 75%; SHAPE master's and J.D. 60%; LL.M., MS Economics and certificates 0%. Stipend months: PhD 45, master's 21.
The School of Education is not among the seven colleges named on the scholarship page; the MA in Comparative Education is included because the university lists it as a graduate programme.
